 How to watch Bucks vs Heat
 Date: Wednesday, November 18, 2026
 Time: 7 PM EDT
 Channel: ESPN, ESPN Deportes
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Miami Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo will clash with some familiar faces on Wednesday when he takes on Milwaukee for the first time since his summer switch. 'The Greek Freak' hopes to extend the Heat's five-win streak in the Eastern Conference while condemning his old team to an 11th straight loss.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Bucks make the trip east last in the Eastern and are one of only three teams in the NBA still on just a solitary win this season. Giannis spent 13 seasons in Milwaukee before making his move to the Kaseya Center, where Miami is 4-3 this season but has now won four in a row after losing its first three home games of the season.
 The Milwaukee icon, who played a leading role in the Bucks ending their 5-year wait for a Championship in 2021, described Wednesday's showdown as "just another game" when asked following Monday's 128-110 win over Houston. Giannis has registered a double-double in 10 of his last 11 appearances and is averaging 29.6 points per game thus far in November as he looks to get one over on his old team.
 Miami center Bam Adebayo and forward Nikola Jovic will face game-time decisions on Wednesday, with the former withdrawn midway through Monday's win over the Rockets as a precaution. Bucks guard Ryan Rollins missed Sunday's 113-106 home loss to Atlanta through illness but could return in midweek, while forward Ousmane Dieng is out after undergoing surgery on a fractured finger.
